segments.text: We first tried Cloud accounting in 208. At the time, competition mattered because competitors moved online and took some market share.
The biggest issue was Skills gap. Without steady power in Aba, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Cloud accounting—we saw Better cashflow visibility within 6 months.
Policy-wise, Regulatory licenses shaped our move. We adjusted by Alternative power.
Data helped; even a low-code AutoML gave us clearer demand patterns during Christmas.
